metric: Accuracy at deciding whether two queries are equivalent, with no model at run time. SQL-IQ's leaderboard lists language models at 69.9% to 78.4%.
caveats: Needs a SQL-IQ checkout (not bundled); Rerun 2026-10-02: 1158 without the targeted-database stage, 1165 with it; 6 of the 19 pairs it decides are 'equivalent' labels refuted on a confirmed database (label disputes). Database realism and trial count were chosen for realism, not per pair.
correctness: Scored against the benchmark's labels only; about 9% of remaining misses look like label errors
